# Nexora AI

> Nexora is an intelligent AI writing assistant, document-analysis engine, and multimodal PDF reasoning workspace.

Website: https://ai-nexoraa.netlify.app/

## Capabilities
- **Deep Document & PDF Analysis**: Extract semantic structure, search full PDF contents, synthesize lengthy research papers, and generate MCQs.
- **Legal Citation & Judgment Reporting**: Standardized legal citation generation supporting Bluebook, OSCOLA, Neutral Citation, AIR, SCC, PLD, and SCMR formats.
- **Multimodal Visual Intelligence**: Parse handwritten notes, diagrams, charts, infographics, and scanned pages.
- **Multilingual Fluency**: Native language generation in English, Urdu (اردو), Hindi (हिंदी), Arabic (العربية), Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), and 40+ global languages.
- **Export & Voice**: Export to PDF, Markdown, and Plain Text, with realistic text-to-speech audio playback.
